title: Rails info page is exposed
summary: The Rails properties page shows framework and gem versions, which points an attacker straight at known vulnerabilities.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("Ruby version") or body_contains("Rails version")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Block /rails/info in production (it is only meant for development).
